scientific_question: Is the independently validated v188 failure caused specifically by truncating each camera's detector potential to 143 DCT12 modes, or does a discrepancy remain even after retaining every non-DC detector DCT mode?
role: post-open root-cause attribution diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p=22kw_size=01 frames; it is an exact positive-control bridge between v188 and v185, not predictor training, a complete-trajectory gate, a resource benchmark, fresh generalization, or real BOST
physical_hypothesis: A full orthonormal 24x24 detector DCT with only the per-camera DC coefficient removed is information-preserving for the frozen zero-mean camera potentials. Therefore its setup-local Moore-Penrose inverse must reproduce the independently validated dense-potential v185 coordinates and K0/K1 fields. If it does, the v188 gap is attributable to its 12x12 spectral truncation rather than cross-camera pooling or the affine inverse itself.
physical_distinction: v189 keeps the v188 potential integration, camera separation and canonical order, affine field basis, p22 frames, reported geometries, five/all-nine sensor arms, fixed-threshold setup-local pseudoinverse, K0/K1 refinement, metrics, gates, and call ledger unchanged. Its only scientific change is to replace each camera's leading 12x12 less-DC block with all 24x24 DCT modes except DC. It adds no descriptor, ridge, damping, fallback, search, learned parameter, or new data.

data_isolation.fit_source: reuse only the sealed v186.1 affine center and 1009-row basis; rebuild the 26 full-DCT response matrices from frozen reported geometry and forward operators
data_isolation.heldout_source: the same already-open p=22kw_size=01 frame indices 0,25,75,100 used by v185-v187; build deployment-visible observations and detector potentials through the frozen forward and potential integration
heldout_truth_forbidden_from: camera roster, DCT coefficients, response matrices, SVD threshold, retained rank, coordinates, K0 field, K1 step size, fallback, and stopping
any descriptor, regularizer, candidate, threshold, or decision choice
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observations through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after observation-only K0 candidates are sealed

primary.name: camera_resolved_full_dct_setup_local_pseudoinverse
primary.per_camera_transform: place each camera's zero-mean scalar detector potential on its frozen 24x24 detector grid with invalid cells exactly zero, apply orthonormal type-II 2D DCT, flatten the complete 24x24 coefficient grid in C order, and remove only its DC coefficient
primary.camera_order: sort active canonical camera IDs numerically and concatenate their 575-mode rows; input camera iteration order cannot change the feature
primary.reported_geometry_use: reported geometry determines the active canonical camera IDs, vector/scalar ray operators, valid detector rows, and detector grid only; no Plucker or other camera descriptor is appended
primary.formal_inverse: thin scipy.linalg.svd of H with LAPACK gesdd; retain singular values s_i >= s_0*sqrt(float64 epsilon); apply the Moore-Penrose inverse for either tall or wide H
primary.independent_inverse: thin scipy.linalg.svd of independently rebuilt H with LAPACK gesvd and the identical threshold
primary.coordinate: for H=U diag(s) V^T and observation feature f, a=(f V_r / s_r) U_r^T; the full-DCT right transform is orthonormal on the zero-mean potential subspace and must reproduce the dense-potential v185 coordinate

blocking_references.v188_camera_resolved_dct12: independently validated negative 143-mode-per-camera result; direct truncation control with no retuning
blocking_references.v185_dense_camera_resolved_potential: independently validated positive dense-potential K1 result; exact information-equivalence target with no rerun or retuning

evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned physical CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual and denominator floor 1e-30
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset frozen before p22 truth was opened

cost_ledger.geometry_cache: 26 full camera-resolved 24x24 DCT response matrices, scalar-potential setup integration, and setup-local SVD factors are offline diagnostic costs and must be reported separately
cost_ledger.resource_claim: none before a separately frozen compact predictor, complete-trajectory matched accuracy, fresh-process wall, and whole-pipeline RSS

required_validity_gates: v185 and v188 bound decisions and sealed formal/validation trees remain unchanged, including the v188 closure over v186.1 and v187.1
all 26 response matrices and 104 heldout feature rows are rebuilt without heldout scoring truth entering the feature or inverse API
five-camera features have exactly 2875 finite values and all-nine features exactly 5175 finite values
each active camera contributes exactly 575 non-DC modes in sorted canonical camera-ID order and every detector potential remains zero mean within tolerance 1e-10
the full DCT satisfies Parseval and zero-DC inverse roundtrip checks within relative tolerance 1e-12

the formal and independent response Frobenius norms, all 1009 response-row norms, deterministic eight-column response sketches, singular spectra, coordinates, and fields agree within tolerance 1e-8 despite separate feature and SVD implementations; full dense response arrays are streamed and not retained
after v189 candidates are sealed, singular values, coordinates, K0/K1 fields, and metrics agree with the sealed dense-potential v185 primary within tolerance 1e-8
each fixed-threshold SVD retains at least one finite positive singular value and reports rank, condition, reconstruction residual, stationarity, and retained-left-subspace coordinate fraction
the prediction API accepts no truth, trajectory, time, power, or size input
fixed-observation truth mutation leaves coordinates and K0 candidates byte-identical
reversing input camera iteration order leaves canonical features, response matrices, coordinates, and K0 fields unchanged within 1e-10
K0/K1 candidates, metrics, and exact-call arrays are finite and match the frozen shapes
physical K1 has no denominator breakdown
formal and all parent input trees remain unchanged
the independent second implementation passes every required comparison

must_independently_rebuild: all scalar detector potentials and complete per-camera non-DC DCT feature rows using an independent camera loop and DCT call
all 26 response matrices, gesvd pseudoinverses, ranks, conditions, coordinates, reconstruction residuals, and stationarity
p22 fields, calibrations, frozen five-camera selections, exact vector operators, K0 fields, unchanged physical K1 fields, metrics, tails, decisions, and call receipts
equivalence to the sealed v185 dense-potential singular spectra, coordinates, primary K0/K1 fields, and metrics after independent candidates are complete

decision_order: Any parent, identity, isolation, shape, full-DCT, Parseval, roundtrip, camera-order, SVD, rank, stationarity, mutation, v185-equivalence, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v189 inconclusive.

If full-DCT K1 passes 52/52 cells and 13/13 calibrations in both sensor arms and equivalence to the sealed v185 dense primary passes, conclude PASS_DCT12_TRUNCATION_ROOT_CAUSE_V189: v188 failed because its 12x12 spectral truncation discarded necessary camera-resolved potential information under this post-open affine-capacity gate.

If full-DCT K1 fails either sensor arm despite all validity and independent-recomputation gates passing, conclude FAIL_DENSE_CAMERA_RESOLVED_DCT_CAPACITY_V189: a discrepancy remains beyond DCT12 truncation and the expected v185 equivalence is not supported.

A passing v189 result authorizes only a separately frozen compact representation diagnostic targeting discarded modes. It does not authorize neural training, deployment, resource claims, an untouched external gate, or real BOST.
No v189 outcome proves mathematical impossibility or supports first, SOTA, global uniqueness, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
